Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is at an inflection point in its growth, and this is a rare opportunity to shape how the world's most accurate AI translation company engages enterprise customers, creates pipeline and scales through partners globally. As Director of Global Field & Partner Marketing, you will own two tightly integrated functions: a global field and events programme spanning owned, third-party and executive formats, and a partner marketing capability that activates DeepL's growing ecosystem of channel, technology and integration partners.

You will lead a distributed team of regional field marketers and partner marketers across EMEA, APJ (dotted line) and North America, unifying them under a single commercial strategy that is directly accountable to pipeline creation, deal acceleration, adoption and expansion revenue.

This role reports directly to the VP of Demand Generation and sits at the heart of DeepL's go-to-market motion.

Your responsibilities

GLOBAL FIELD MARKETING & EVENTS

  • Own and scale DeepL's global field marketing programme across owned events, third-party conference activations, executive engagement formats and digital programmes - driving net new pipeline, deal acceleration and product adoption across mid-market and enterprise segments.

  • Define and manage the global field marketing strategy, ensuring programme investment is allocated to the highest-return formats and markets and adjusted in response to pipeline signals and sales priorities.

  • Lead the evolution of DeepL's flagship owned programme portfolio scaling them across new cities and regions while maintaining quality, commercial rigour and local relevance.

  • Build and scale an executive engagement capability in close partnership with Sales and Customer Success, creating access to senior decision-makers within priority accounts through intimate, high-value formats.

  • Partner with Sales, SDR, Revenue Intelligence and Marketing Ops to establish rigorous measurement frameworks covering pipeline sourced, pipeline influenced, speed-to-lead and closed-won attribution - and use these insights to drive continuous programme optimisation.

  • Champion a culture of commercial accountability: every programme format is evaluated against pipeline outcomes, and investment decisions are made on evidence, not habit.

PARTNER MARKETING

  • Lead DeepL's partner marketing function, developing and executing co-marketing strategies with channel partners, technology partners, GSIs, ISVs and integration partners that generate measurable pipeline and expand DeepL's market reach.

  • Build scalable co-marketing frameworks - including joint event programmes, partner-led demand generation, marketplace activations and partner enablement content - that allow partners to market DeepL effectively within their own networks and customer bases.

  • Own partner-attached pipeline targets and contribution to ARR, ensuring partner marketing programmes are designed to drive measurable commercial outcomes rather than activity metrics.

  • Partner closely with the Partnerships, Sales, Product Marketing and Creative Studio teams to develop partner-specific messaging, assets and campaign frameworks that reflect DeepL's positioning while enabling partner customisation.

  • Develop and manage the partner marketing calendar globally, with clear accountability for joint pipeline targets, co-investment frameworks and performance reporting.

  • Continuously evolve the partner marketing operating model to support DeepL's growing partner ecosystem, including emerging opportunities with hyperscalers, marketplace listings and developer community programmes.

LEADERSHIP & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

  • Lead, inspire and develop a high-performing, globally distributed team of field marketers and partner marketers, fostering a culture of commercial accountability, creativity and continuous improvement.

  • Serve as the key marketing partner to Sales, SDR, Customer Success, Product Marketing and Partnerships leadership - aligning field and partner activity directly to pipeline targets, territory plans and revenue objectives.

  • Represent field and partner marketing at senior leadership level, clearly articulating strategy, programme performance, investment rationale and regional market insights.

  • Build and maintain strong operating cadences with Sales leadership across all regions, ensuring tight alignment on target account lists, programme priorities and follow-up execution.

Qualities we look for

  • 12–15 years of experience in field marketing, events and/or partner marketing, with significant time spent in B2B SaaS — ideally within a global scale-up of 500+ employees.

  • Demonstrated success building and scaling owned event programmes - including executive engagement series, flagship conferences and multi-city roadshows - with direct accountability for sourced and influenced pipeline outcomes.

  • Proven track record in partner marketing, including co-marketing programme design, partner enablement and partner-attached pipeline generation across channel, technology and GSI partner ecosystems.

  • Strong AI literacy, with hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to scale field marketing operations, automate campaign execution workflows and improve programme ROI - including use cases across event setup automation, content personalisation, lead scoring and follow-up cadence management.

  • Proven ability to embed AI into field marketing operating models, driving efficiency gains, faster execution cycles and improved pipeline outcomes.

  • Experience leading and developing a geographically distributed team of 6+ marketers across multiple regions, with a track record of building strong team cultures and developing regional marketers into senior contributors.

  • Deep familiarity with the enterprise B2B buying cycle - including the interplay between field-sourced pipeline, SDR follow-up, sales acceleration and partner-influenced revenue.

  • Exceptional commercial instincts: you are comfortable owning pipeline targets, interpreting SFDC attribution data and using programme performance insights to influence investment decisions at the leadership level.

  • Strong cross-functional instincts - you are a natural collaborator who can align Sales, Partnerships, SDR and Product Marketing around shared field and partner priorities without formal authority.

  • Excellent programme management capabilities, with the ability to maintain clarity and momentum across a complex global event calendar, multiple partner co-marketing initiatives and a distributed team operating across time zones.

  • A practical, proactive mindset: you balance strategic programme design with genuine willingness to be in the detail when it matters - from reviewing a post-event attribution report to being on the ground at a flagship event.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

Please note that this is a hybrid position in Cardiff with a mixture of in-office and home-based working.

Every game is an ecosystem beyond mere gameplay. At Terminal Velocity, part of the Rocket Science Group, our platform and server teams are dedicated to constructing the infrastructure necessary for your game's global rollout through a strong focus on back-end and publishing stacks.

We are looking for a Data Platform Engineer to help us design, build, and improve reliable data systems for our partners and internal teams.

This is primarily a data engineering role. Your greatest strengths should be in areas such as data pipelines, data modelling, data quality, observability, and making data trustworthy. Adaptability is hugely important here. We work across a wide range of technical problems, so we are looking for someone who is also willing to step into adjacent areas such as backend services, web development, infrastructure, or SDK development when the opportunity arises.

We do not expect you to be an expert in all of those areas. We care more about strong data engineering depth, good software engineering skills, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly.

About the Role:

In this role, you will build scalable and resilient data solutions for games and related platforms. You may work on telemetry pipelines, analytics platforms, data warehouse and lakehouse design, reporting foundations, or backend integrations.

You will be expected to speak directly with stakeholders and customers, clarify vague requirements, break down complex work, estimate and plan delivery, and make pragmatic technical trade-offs.

Prior games industry experience is useful, but not required. Strong data engineering experience, good engineering judgement, and the ability to work with ambiguity are much more important.

data.description:
About BJAK

BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted.

We are hiring a Head of Compliance and Risk (UK) to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA.

This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function.

 

Why This Role Matters

The Head of Compliance and Risk (UK) will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

 

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

 

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

 

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

 

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

 

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic.

  • Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

 

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech.

  • Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements.

  • Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred).

  • Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators.

 

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in start-up or high-growth environments.

  • Previous SMF experience.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

  • Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance.

 

Location Requirement

  • This role is based in the UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

 

Why Join Us

  • Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform.

  • Build frameworks that enable safe, inclusive financial access at scale.

  • Work closely with leadership and regulators to drive responsible innovation.

  • Competitive compensation with long-term growth and international career opportunities.


Compensations Range

  • We offer a highly competitive package, ranging from £100,000 to £150,000, reflecting both experience and suitability for this pivotal role.

data.title: Software Engineer (AI)
data.description:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.

The Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join ExTrac's AI team, building Co-Analyst and the analytical AI features around it.

Co-Analyst is a user-facing multi-agent system that works alongside intelligence analysts to research and write reports. A planning loop decomposes an analyst's question, fans work out to sub-agents, and assembles the results into a report where every claim traces back to the chunk of source it came from. Underneath sits hybrid retrieval over a large unstructured corpus: analyst intent translated into structured filters, combined with keyword and dense vector search, across multiple languages and media types.

The agent work is the centrepiece but not the whole job. In a single quarter the work spans agent orchestration, retrieval, graph analytics, and long-running streaming pipelines, alongside the services and databases underneath them. You will own well-defined features and components end to end across a Python and Go codebase, working alongside senior engineers who set technical direction, the data team who own the ingestion pipelines, and a research-focused ML team who train and evaluate the models we integrate and serve. The loop is short: product brings an idea, often recent and unproven, and our job is to spike an implementation and take it to a production feature. New features land close to weekly.

This hire exists to add capacity on the AI team's hard problems: an engineer who can independently deliver well-scoped features and components, and who is building towards owning more of the system end to end.

What the job involves

Agentic and analytical AI features

  • Build and improve components of the agent loop itself: context assembly, tool selection, and sub-agent orchestration, with guidance from senior engineers on the team.

  • Build the analytical AI features that sit alongside it, from network construction through to the summaries analysts read.

  • Help prove that changes are improvements, running experiments against live analyst traffic behind feature flags.

  • Contribute to agreeing what "better" means for a capability, and flag honestly when the evidence says a promising approach is not working.

  • Work with embeddings as more than a retrieval concern. The same vectors drive network construction and community detection.

  • Work within a model-agnostic design, swapping models and embeddings on the back of the ML team's evaluations rather than being locked to one.

Service design and delivery

  • Take a well-defined problem, clarify requirements with your lead or a senior engineer, and ship it to production with regular check-ins rather than close oversight.

  • Own features and components end to end within a single system, contributing to system design and architecture discussions and taking on more of the design work as you build context.

  • Build and maintain APIs used by internal teams and customers, following established contracts and versioning conventions.

  • Work with the storage layer as a design concern rather than an implementation detail: schema, indexing strategy, and access patterns, across relational, document, and vector stores.

Production engineering

  • Build and operate supporting services across Python and Go, with growing ownership of design, deployment, and operations as you build track record.

  • Help hold agent workflows to production standards for latency, cost, and reliability, in a system where non-determinism is a given.

  • Build and operate long-running streaming pipelines, including the caching and recovery behaviour that makes them survivable.

Working with analysts, product, and the ML team

  • Work directly with the analysts who use our products, turning what they hit in practice into changes in the system.

  • Iterate quickly against a live stream of product requests, flagging where they collide with longer-horizon capability work.

  • Partner with the ML team on agentic approaches, helping take proven concepts to production and working through the engineering, performance, and reliability problems a research implementation does not have to.

  • Help integrate and serve the models they train, and contribute to the production infrastructure their evaluation frameworks run on.

You should apply if

  • You have built and worked on production backend systems, and you want to keep doing that. You will spend more of your time in Python and Go services, databases, and APIs than in a prompt file, and you know the difference between something that demos well and something that holds up under production load, latency, and cost.

  • You are curious about agentic frameworks and comfortable working without one. Experience with them is useful, but we build most of our own orchestration, because off-the-shelf abstractions have not survived our requirements around evaluation, control, and production performance.

  • You can take a recent technique or paper, help spike an implementation, and reason clearly about whether it is worth taking further.

  • You do not trust a change until you have measured it. Reaching for the evaluation is instinct rather than afterthought.

  • You actively seek feedback and act on it, and you look for opportunities to pair with and learn from the engineers around you.

  • You want to work on things that matter. Our software sits underneath decisions taken by governments, defence organisations, and institutions operating where being wrong or late carries real consequences.

Where this role can take you

  • Grow into full ownership. Strong performance means owning larger features and whole services end to end, writing the technical designs others build on, and leading reviews rather than only taking part in them. That is the path to Senior, and it is a path we will actively work with you on.

  • Breadth rather than a narrow track. The work follows the problem, which means agent orchestration one month and pipeline, retrieval, or infrastructure work the next. Engineers here have the opportunity to build depth across several areas rather than being funnelled into one.

  • Work on a class of system nobody has settled yet. There are established patterns for running web services and for training models. There are none yet for operating agentic systems in production: controlling cost and latency, making non-deterministic behaviour dependable, and knowing when a change is genuinely an improvement. You will be helping work those out, and that experience is still rare.

  • Take on a different class of problem. Making our systems work inside FedRAMP environments is a major upcoming project, and engineering under that kind of constraint is a skill set that stays with you.

Requirements

Due to the nature of our work and the clients we support, applicants must be eligible to obtain UK security clearance. We are currently only able to consider applicants who are nationals of a NATO member state, Australia, or New Zealand.

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to build and ship production-grade services with solid test coverage, and experience owning features or components end to end within a larger system.

  • Proficiency in building services in Python, with working knowledge of Go or the ability to pick it up quickly.

  • Some exposure to agentic systems, LLM applications, or retrieval running in production, or clear evidence you would pick them up fast.

  • A good understanding of distributed systems and databases, including writing asynchronous code that performs under load.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and the CI/CD pipelines around it.

  • Comfortable working with trunk-based deployment.

  • Comfortable being handed a symptom rather than a diagnosis. Given a suspected memory leak, you would profile it, find the cause, and fix it, asking for support when you get stuck.

  • Able to take a well-defined requirement and scope a technical approach from it, asking clarifying questions up front rather than assuming. You communicate clearly in writing and can produce documentation colleagues can follow, and you look for a way through rather than concluding something cannot be done.

  • Breadth and curiosity across the stack: an interest in deployment pipelines, database behaviour, security and AI guardrails, and in validating analytical outputs and feeding analyst feedback into requirements. You pick up unfamiliar tools quickly rather than needing prior expertise in a specific one.

Desirable

  • Experience with retrieval systems and large-scale vector database performance (Elastic).

  • Experience with graph or network analysis at scale.

  • Experience building retrieval or analysis that works across multiple languages.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code, streaming pipelines, and search infrastructure.

  • Experience operating multi-tenant systems where data isolation is a hard requirement.

Als Finance Analyst übernimmst du Verantwortung für Planung, Controlling und Analyse für unsere Agri-PV-Projekte. Du übernimmst zentrale Themen in unserem Finance Bereich und bist für die strategische Weiterentwicklung zuständig. Eine hands-on Rolle mit direktem Impact.

feld energy ist mehr als nur ein Unternehmen – wir sind eine Bewegung!

Mit unseren innovativen Agri-Photovoltaik-Lösungen nutzen wir Flächen doppelt – für Lebensmittel und saubere Energie. So schaffen wir gemeinsam eine nachhaltigere und wirtschaftlichere Landwirtschaft.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Als Finance Analyst erstellst und entwickelst du Business Cases und Finanzmodelle für unsere Agri-PV-Projekte und unterstützt bei der laufenden Unternehmensplanung.

data.title: AI Transformation Lead (m/w/d)
data.description:
Hast du in Beratung oder Transformation gelernt, wie Veränderung geht, aber selten gesehen, was aus deinen Konzepten wurde? Willst du KI-Transformation verantworten, statt sie nur zu empfehlen?

Mein Kunde ist eine PE-finanzierte, europaweit stark wachsende Unternehmensgruppe mit mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden und klarer Buy-&-Build-Strategie. über 150 Partnerunternehmen an mehr als 100 Standorte. Getragen von zwei renommierten Private-Equity-Investoren verfolgt die Gruppe eine klare Buy-&-Build-Strategie und baut sich gezielt zum technologie- und KI-gestützten Makler und Assekuradeur um. Die Mission: Europas führenden KI-gestützten Versicherungsmakler aufbauen, mit AI-Lösungen, die die Unternehmen der Gruppe produktiver machen, bessere Entscheidungen ermöglichen und Kunden einen spürbaren Mehrwert bieten.

Dafür wird gerade ein komplett neues, zentrales AI-Team mit direkter COO-Anbindung aufgebaut. Parallel zu dieser Rolle werden die Forward Deployed AI Engineers gesucht, mit denen du zusammenarbeitest. Für die Investoren ist KI kein Kostenfaktor, sondern zentraler Werttreiber, entsprechend stehen Budget und Rückhalt des gesamten Management Boards dahinter.

Du verantwortest die AI-Transformation eines kompletten Geschäftsbereichs, End-to-End: entweder im Maklergeschäft oder im Assekuradeursgeschäft der Gruppe. Du bist regelmäßig unterwegs zu den Häusern, sprichst mit den lokalen Geschäftsführern, verstehst ihre Abläufe und treibst von dort aus die Transformation voran. Du nimmst Prozesse auf, denkst sie mit KI neu und sorgst dafür, dass Lösungen nicht nur gebaut, sondern wirklich genutzt werden. Die Rolle verlangt jemanden, der strukturiert denkt, Menschen bewegt und sich zwischen Geschäftsführerebene und operativem Alltag gleichermaßen sicher bewegt.

Ehrlich gesagt: Vieles entsteht hier gerade erst, Strukturen, Standards, Spielregeln. Wenn du fertige Prozesse suchst, ist das nichts für dich. Wenn du sie bauen willst, schon.

Aufgaben

  • End-to-End-Verantwortung: Du identifizierst, priorisierst und realisierst AI-Use-Cases für deinen Geschäftsbereich, von der ersten Idee über die Steuerung aller Stakeholder bis zum produktiven Einsatz und zur Verankerung in der Organisation.
  • Prozesse neu denken: Du nimmst bestehende Geschäftsprozesse auf, hinterfragst sie kritisch und entwirfst sie mit KI von Grund auf neu, nicht nur effizienter.
  • Strategischer Ansprechpartner: Du übernimmst die Beziehung zu den lokalen Geschäftsführern und Fachbereichsleitern, bist ihr primärer Ansprechpartner für KI-Transformation und treibst die organisatorische Verankerung der Lösungen voran.
  • Engineering-Koordination: Du koordinierst die Forward Deployed AI Engineers, die deine priorisierten Use Cases technisch umsetzen, und stellst sicher, dass Lösungen im Alltag ankommen.
  • Gruppenweite AI-Strategie: Du gestaltest die AI-Strategie der gesamten Gruppe aktiv mit und bringst die Erfahrungen aus deinem Bereich in die zentrale Roadmap ein.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung und Erfahrung: Abgeschlossenes Studium auf Bachelor- oder Master-Niveau oder vergleichbare Qualifikation, dazu mindestens 4 bis 6 Jahre in Transformation, Unternehmensberatung, Projektmanagement oder im Start-up-Umfeld.
  • Projektsteuerung: Du hast nachweislich komplexe Projekte mit mehreren Stakeholdern gesteuert und weißt, wie man Interessen ausbalanciert, ohne das Ziel aus den Augen zu verlieren.
  • Prozessanalyse und -design: Du weißt, wie man Prozesse strukturiert aufnimmt, bewertet und neu konzipiert, und übersetzt das in priorisierte, umsetzbare Roadmaps.
  • Technisches Verständnis: Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen LLMs, Schnittstellen und modernen AI-Architekturen, genug, um mit den AI Engineers auf Augenhöhe zu arbeiten, ohne selbst coden zu müssen.
  • Unternehmerisches Mindset und Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst souverän auf allen Ebenen bis C-Level und denkst in Ergebnissen statt in Zuständigkeiten.
  • Sprachen: Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, Englisch verhandlungssicher für internationale Einheiten, Investoren und externe Partner.

Benefits

  • Schlüsselrolle: Die KI-Transformation eines kompletten Geschäftsbereichs in einer der größten Makler- und Assekuradeursgruppen Europas, mit echtem unternehmerischem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Direkter Zugang: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem C-Level der Gruppe und den Geschäftsführern der einzelnen Unternehmen, kurze Entscheidungswege inklusive.
  • Umsetzungskraft: Eigene Engineers, die bauen, was du priorisierst, statt Empfehlungen, die in Schubladen landen.
  • Umfeld: Ein hochmotiviertes, unternehmerisch denkendes Team, das schnelles Lernen und eigenverantwortliches Handeln belohnt.
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Hamburg bevorzugt, alternativ Köln, Frankfurt oder München, 3 bis 4 Tage remote möglich, regelmäßige Präsenz in den Häusern der Gruppe.
  • Attraktives Gehaltspackage mit ca. 15-20% variablem Anteil, freier Hardwarewahl und einem individuell abgestimmten Benefitpackage

Was die Rolle sonst noch prägt

  • Fachliche, nicht disziplinarische Führung: Engineers, externe Partner und virtuelle Projektteams werden auf ein Ziel hin geführt – ohne Weisungsbefugnis, auch gegenüber den Geschäftsführern der Häuser.
  • Wirkung über den Business Case: Niemand wird von oben zur Umsetzung verpflichtet. Überzeugt wird im Dialog und über Zahlen. Wer sich trotzdem sperrt, wird nicht bekämpft – man weicht auf das nächste Haus aus. Bei echtem Stillstand steht das Group Management Board dahinter.
  • Präsenz in den Häusern: Regelmäßige Reisetätigkeit, zu Beginn erhöht. Kredibilität entsteht vor Ort.
  • Hands-on-Anteil: Kein tiefes Coden gefordert, aber Augenhöhe mit Engineers und im Idealfall die Fähigkeit, einen MVP selbst hochzuziehen – wegen des Tempos.
  • Fingerspitzengefühl: Effizienzgewinne bedeuten später, dass bei Mehrgeschäft nicht automatisch mehr eingestellt wird. Das muss fair und nachvollziehbar platziert werden.

data.title: Senior Associate - Strategy & Corporate Development (m/w/d)
Full Stack Developer - AI Integration (f/m/d)
data.description:
About Us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects.

About Our Technology

The semiconductor industry's growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude. In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.

The Role

Black Net is our internal digital platform — the operational backbone that keeps the company running as we scale. It handles everything from time tracking and absence management to project reimbursements, procurement, and more. It is not a side project: it is how our employees get things done every day. Black Net is greenfield in the truest sense. The architecture decisions are modern, the codebase is clean, and the product is expanding into new territory every quarter.


As we grow rapidly toward our first pilot production in FabONE, the demands on our internal tooling are growing just as fast. We are looking for a Full Stack Developer with a genuine passion for AI-augmented development.


In this role, you will not just build features — you will also be the person who brings AI-powered development practices into the team. You will set up tools like Claude Code and similar AI coding assistants, integrate them into our workflow, and help your colleagues get the most out of them. Part builder, part enabler.

To Join Our Team, You Should Be Excited To:

  • Design and implement full-stack features across our internal network (Angular, Node.js, MongoDB)

  • Champion AI-augmented development within the team: set up, configure, and maintain tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar

  • Collaborate closely with the Product Owner to translate requirements and user stories into working software

  • Contribute to architecture decisions as Black Net expands its feature surface (ERP integration, procurement workflows, and beyond)

  • Integrate AI coding agents and automation into Black Net's processes

  • Participate in code reviews with an eye for quality, maintainability, and scalability

  • Refine existing best practices and team agreements as the team grows

  • Occasionally run knowledge-sharing sessions so that all team members can benefit from AI coding tools

Your Qualifications

Must have:

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience in full stack web development

  • Proficiency in TypeScript and experience with a modern frontend framework — Angular is our stack, but strong React or Vue candidates will be considered

  • Backend development experience with Node.js and REST API design

  • Hands-on experience with a document or relational database (we use MongoDB)

  • Active experience with at least one AI coding assistant (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codeium, or similar) — not just awareness, but genuine daily use

  • Ability to explain AI tooling and development concepts clearly to colleagues with varying technical backgrounds

  • A self-starter mindset: comfortable working in a small team where there is no large support structure, and where you will often define the way things get done

Nice to have:

  • Background in B2B environments, building enterprise applications, internal tooling or integrating systems like ERP or HR (e.g. SAP, Personio, Workday)

  • Experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.), prompt engineering, agentic AI frameworks, or background job orchestration

  • Familiarity with Docker containerisation and CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions)

What Makes This Role Different

Most developer roles ask you to use the tools. This one asks you to shape how the whole team uses them. You will have real influence over how AI-augmented development takes root at Black Semiconductor — and the results will be visible across the entire company.

At the same time, you are joining a company at one of the most exciting points in its journey: construction of FabONE has started, pilot production is planned for 2026, and the team is scaling fast.

Our Work Culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters.

Let's Grow Together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development.

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority — in the present and future.

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward.

We connect chips — and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry.

Can you picture yourself in this role and our company? Let's connect.

data.title: Senior Buchhalter (w/m/d)
data.description:
Übernimm Verantwortung für unser General Ledger und gestalte unsere Finance-Strukturen mit.

Black Semiconductor wächst international und baut seine Finance-Organisation für die nächste Wachstumsphase weiter aus. In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du Verantwortung für unser General Ledger und den Closing-Prozess und sorgst gleichzeitig dafür, dass unsere Accounting-Prozesse mit unserem Wachstum Schritt halten.

Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, bestehende Prozesse zuverlässig auszuführen. Du bringst Deine Erfahrung ein, entwickelst Strukturen weiter und gestaltest gemeinsam mit unserem Finance-Team den Aufbau unserer deutschen und niederländischen Gesellschaften mit.

 

Warum diese Rolle?

 

Ownership für General Ledger & Closing: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Hauptbuchhaltung sowie Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse und bist eine wichtige Säule für die Qualität unseres Accountings.

Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du arbeitest nicht nur mit bestehenden Strukturen, sondern entwickelst Accounting- und Closing-Prozesse aktiv weiter und schaffst Strukturen, die mit unserem Wachstum skalieren.

Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum: Du kannst Deine Erfahrung einbringen, Prozesse hinterfragen und gemeinsam mit dem Finance-Team Standards und Strukturen weiterentwickeln.

Internationale Perspektive: Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Strukturen im Zuge unseres Wachstums mit.

Hands-on & abwechslungsreich: Du bist nah am operativen Geschäft und kannst Deine fachliche Expertise dort einbringen, wo sie gebraucht wird.

Entwicklungsperspektive: Mit unserem Wachstum können auch Deine Verantwortlichkeiten wachsen – perspektivisch mit weiteren Aufgaben rund um internationale Gesellschaften und gruppenweite Finance-Strukturen.

Scale-up mit Corporate-Anspruch: Du verbindest die Dynamik eines wachsenden Unternehmens mit anspruchsvollen Finance-Themen und der Möglichkeit, Strukturen aktiv mitzugestalten.

 

Über uns

 

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

 

Unsere Technology

 

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

 

Deine Aufgaben

 

Verantwortung für unser General Ledger: Du übernimmst die Hauptbuchhaltung und stellst eine zuverlässige und qualitativ hochwertige Finanzbuchhaltung sicher.

Closing & Abschlüsse: Du verantwortest die Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse und sorgst für einen strukturierten und effizienten Closing-Prozess.

Operative Accounting-Exzellenz: Du übernimmst operative Accounting-Aufgaben, führst Kontenabstimmungen durch und stellst eine hohe Qualität unserer Finanzdaten sicher.

Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du hinterfragst bestehende Accounting-Prozesse, entwickelst sie weiter und schaffst gemeinsam mit dem Finance-Team effiziente und skalierbare Strukturen.

 

Das bringst Du mit

 

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im General Ledger Accounting, in der Finanzbuchhaltung oder im Closing

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse der deutschen Rechnungslegung und relevanter HGB-Anforderungen

  • Erfahrung in der operativen Buchhaltung sowie Freude daran, Verantwortung für das Tagesgeschäft zu übernehmen

  • Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Freude daran, bestehende Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln und Strukturen in einem wachsenden Unternehmen aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

 

Was wir Dir bieten

 

Entwicklung: Mit dem Wachstum von Black Semiconductor kann auch Dein Verantwortungsbereich wachsen – perspektivisch bis hin zur Verantwortung für Group Reporting & Consolidation und zum Aufbau eines Teams.

Beteiligung: Du erhältst virtuelle Aktienoptionen und partizipierst damit am langfristigen Erfolg unseres Unternehmens.

Flexibilität: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit einer Anwesenheit von ca. einem Tag pro Woche in Aachen.

Gesundheit & Zukunft: Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Wir bieten Dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit Versicherungs-, Vorsorge- und weiteren Benefits.

Zukunftsbranche: Arbeite an einer Technologie, die die nächste Generation der Halbleiter-Konnektivität mitgestalten soll.

 

Unsere Kultur

 

Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel - wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit Du Dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst.

Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten Dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern Dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in Deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion sind die Eckpfeiler unserer Kultur. Wir praktizieren Offenheit und fördern Vertrauen und Respekt. Individualität ist unsere kollektive Stärke, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt und uns voranbringt.

Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir ermutigen qualifizierte Personen mit beliebigem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben. Wir fördern ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Wachstum schätzt. Schließ Dich unserem Team an und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das in der Branche etwas bewirken will.

Kannst Du Dich in dieser Rolle und in unserem Unternehmen wiederfinden? Let's connect.

data.title: CS Enablement Manager (d/f/m)
data.description:
What is Leapsome?

Leapsome is the AI-powered people platform revolutionizing HR for modern teams. Leapsome drives HR excellence and empowers high-performing teams by automating, connecting, and simplifying every HR process across the employee lifecycle — from onboarding and performance management to engagement and development. Built with ease of use in mind, our platform ensures high adoption by employees, managers, and People teams alike.

Our purpose is to make work fulfilling for everyone, and our vision is to reshape the future of work by being the leading People platform for HR excellence and high-performing teams. We enable companies to create environments where people can achieve their goals, learn and grow together, and build genuine motivation & engagement.

Trusted by thousands of organizations globally, Leapsome secured $60 million in Series A funding led by Insight Partners in March 2022. This funding allowed us to further develop our intelligent platform, create exceptional employee experiences, and expand into the US market.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to join Leapsome and be part of reshaping the future of work!

Your Opportunity

Join a high-growth SaaS scale-up and shape how our GTM teams learn, ramp, and perform. As part of the GTM Enablement team, your main focus will be Customer Success and Account Management: the teams responsible for retention and expansion. But enablement at Leapsome is a cross-functional job, so you'll also support Sales and work on initiatives that span the whole GTM org. You'll build enablement the way it should work in 2026, with AI at the core of how knowledge gets created, shared, and put into practice. Please note this opportunity is a 1-year limited contract.

Your Responsibilities

  • Develop and run enablement initiatives that make our CS Growth and CS Care teams measurably better at driving renewals and expansion

  • Build the structures (and the AI-assisted workflows behind them) that let the team scale: knowledge management, meeting formats, and initiative alignment across the GTM org

data.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

📍 Based in Europe or New York, New Jersey, Virginia, Florida, Massachusetts, Georgia.

🎯 Your main goal will be to build and own n8n's enterprise marketing engine from the ground up, turning demand generation, account-based marketing, and field marketing into a predictable, scalable pipeline machine for our enterprise motion.

As our first Enterprise Marketing Director/VP, you'll build the muscle that doesn't exist yet at n8n today, working hand-in-hand with Sales, SDR, Product Marketing, and DevRel to turn n8n's product-led momentum into enterprise pipeline:

Own Demand Generation and ABM for Enterprise

  • Build and run n8n's account-based marketing motion from scratch, targeting Fortune 1000 accounts.

  • Own the enterprise pipeline number in partnership with Sales, tracked through ACV growth and top-of-funnel conversion, not just lead volume.

  • Design and launch the enterprise event and field marketing strategy, including the asset library our SDR and Sales teams need.

Lead Field Marketing

  • Directly manage the Field Marketing team as it scales.

  • Partner proactively with our SDR team on capacity, prioritization, and joint pipeline planning.

  • Build the sales enablement materials — decks, talk tracks, content — that activate our sellers.

Shape Enterprise Positioning

  • Evolve n8n's technical, product-led messaging into business-value language for enterprise buyers like CIOs, CTOs, and technical executives.

  • Contribute input into enterprise-facing brand moments, while brand ownership stays with our Brand team.

  • Build a repeatable playbook for positioning n8n's platform story to enterprise accounts.

Build the Team and the Function

  • Hire and lead the Demand Gen and Field Marketing teams as they scale.

  • Maintain a close, dotted-line partnership with Product Marketing and Developer Relations on enterprise-specific work.

  • Protect and build on n8n's PLG/community motion rather than operating independently of it.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🏗️ Zero-to-one builder: You've built an enterprise marketing function from scratch, not just run one that already existed, and you're willing to roll up your sleeves.

  • 📈 Demand gen and ABM expertise: You have deep experience in pipeline strategy, account-based marketing, field marketing, and campaign orchestration.

  • 🧠 Technical buyer fluency: You understand technical buyers like CIOs and CTOs, and you can bridge developer and executive audiences.

  • 🎯 Revenue rigor: You're comfortable being measured on pipeline, ACV growth, and funnel conversion rather than leads or MQLs, and you know your own numbers cold.

  • 🤝 SDR collaboration: You proactively partner with SDR teams on capacity and prioritization rather than operating in a silo.

  • 🌱 Community fluency: You understand PLG/community-led motions well enough to build alongside them, not against them.

  • 🧩 Matrix comfort: You're comfortable in a dotted-line structure and hold healthy tension with Sales without being subservient or territorial.

  • 🏢 Relevant scale: You've worked at a community-led or PLG-to-SLG technical company, ideally scaling through the $500M–$1B ARR range rather than one already past $1B.

  • 🤖 AI-fluent: You use AI and marketing automation tools as a core part of how you work.

Nice-to-haves

  • 💬 Messaging evolution: You've evolved technical product messaging into business-value messaging for enterprise buyers.

  • 🌍 Global expansion: You've led marketing expansion into APAC or LatAm.

  • 🤝 Partner marketing: You've built a "better together" narrative with technology or channel partners.

  • 🗺️ Dual-region experience: You've led marketing across both the US and Europe.

Why join us? You'll be the first person to own enterprise marketing at n8n, with a mandate from our VP Marketing and VP Sales leadership to build the function from the ground up, not inherit someone else's playbook. n8n's enterprise product-market fit is real, and the window to capture it is now: you'll have direct influence on pipeline, positioning, and how our AI-native platform shows up to the enterprise buyers who are increasingly where our growth comes from. You'll join a remote-first team growing ARR 10x year over year, backed by $58M in funding including Sequoia's first seed in Germany and a Series B led by Highland, with the autonomy to build a real team around you. Apply now and help us bring n8n's community-powered platform to the enterprise world.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

* Country-specific details are provided in your contract.

data.title: Staff Data Engineer (f/m/d)_metrify
data.description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

Metrify is Enpal’s smart metering unit and the digital infrastructure for a smart energy ecosystem. With tens of thousands of iMSys units installed and scalable processes, we make energy measurable, controllable, and economically viable—and, together with our partners, we are laying the groundwork for new business models for the energy transition.

About the Role

Our central data platform is the foundation that Analytics Engineering, BI and increasingly AI-enabled business teams build on top of. You’ll join the team of two Data Engineers, where you’ll define how we build. As a Staff Data Engineer, you build for other engineers rather than for end users or dashboards: you own the technical decisions, pipelines, integrations, tooling and guardrails that let others ship data products safely and fast. You'll work at the intersection of dbt, Snowflake, Airflow orchestration and infrastructure-as-code on Azure – hands-on, while also setting the technical direction for where the platform goes next, building best practices, vision and roadmap.

Our data arrives from metering devices, operational and legacy systems, external partners and APIs. You own the ingestion and orchestration layer that collects, reshapes and delivers it, including the critical paths the business cannot operate without. You'll drive design decisions and reviews directly with stakeholders across the business domains, set the standards others build on, and turn ambiguous requirements into implementable designs.

 

What You'll Do

  • Design, build and operate scalable pipelines end to end - from source integration through dbt models on Snowflake, orchestrated with Airflow on Azure.

  • Own the integration layer. Connect the platform to heterogeneous source systems - operational databases, external partners, APIs - and make those integrations observable, and resilient.

  • Build self-service scaffolding and developer tooling so domain teams can create models, sources, and tests without touching platform internals.

  • Drive the platform vision. Define where our data platform needs to go - tooling, abstractions, self-service, guardrails - and break that direction into increments that land in production. Act as the technical authority for data platform architecture and set the patterns for other engineers to follow.

  • Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform, keeping environments reproducible and reviewable. Collaborate closely with the platform team to align deployment policies and CI/CD setup.

  • Enforce federated governance: data contracts, RBAC via Snowflake database roles, and domain ownership boundaries.

  • Support data privacy and compliance requirements, including metadata-driven PII handling.

  • Build observability and testing into the platform so failures are caught before they reach domain teams.

  • Partner with AE/BI leads to gather requirements, review designs, document patterns, and continuously lower the barrier to entry.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of data engineering experience; you have owned production-critical data platforms.

  • Deep, hands-on dbt experience at scale (especially operating the platform around data modelling).

  • Solid Snowflake knowledge: RBAC, performance, and warehouse management.

  • Comfort with IaC (Terraform) and GitOps (ArgoCD).

  • Experience with orchestration (Airflow) and containerized workloads (Kubernetes/AKS).

  • Familiarity with modern ingestion frameworks (dlt or similar).

  • Software engineering fundamentals: confident Python and advanced SQL, testing, reusable libraries, and a platform-as-product mindset.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder empathy; you enjoy enabling other engineers and can navigate ambiguity in a cross-domain mesh.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building internal developer platforms or paved-road tooling.

  • Knowledge of data contracts and federated data governance.

  • GDPR/DSGVO-aware data handling experience.

  • Streaming experience (Kafka or similar) and work with PostgreSQL.

     

    Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

 

What we offer

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

  • The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

  • The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.

  • Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.

  • Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.

  • Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.

  • The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.

  • Your extra boost - 29 vacation days + one additional day off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance.

At Enpal, we are proud of the diversity of our team. No decisions are made on the basis of skin colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age, either during recruitment or employment. Enpal stands for a safe workplace and takes action against discrimination and harassment of any kind.

data.title: Technical Accounting Expert (f/m/x)
data.description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

What you’ll do

As Technical Accounting Expert (f/m/x), you will take ownership of complex technical accounting matters across the Group, advise senior Finance and business stakeholders, and help shape Enpal’s accounting policies, governance and financial reporting.

  • You take independent ownership of complex technical accounting topics and workstreams, partnering closely with the Head of Technical Accounting and senior Finance stakeholders.

  • You assess new business models, products, transactions and contractual arrangements under IFRS and HGB and develop robust, well-supported accounting conclusions for complex and judgmental matters.

  • You lead the research and assessment of complex accounting topics and prepare high-quality, audit-ready position papers, technical memos and supporting analyses.

  • You act as a trusted accounting advisor to Finance and business stakeholders, translating complex business developments into clear accounting implications and practical solutions.

  • You drive the implementation of technical accounting conclusions into accounting and reporting processes, working closely with GL Accounting, Group Accounting, ERP, Tax, Legal and other relevant functions.

  • You shape and further develop Group accounting policies, guidelines and governance and ensure their consistent application across the organization.

  • You monitor developments in IFRS and HGB, assess their impact on Enpal and lead or support the implementation of new accounting requirements.

  • You provide technical expertise on complex areas such as revenue recognition, leases, financial instruments, provisions, consolidation and business combinations, and represent Technical Accounting in discussions with external auditors and other stakeholders.

  • You contribute to strengthening technical accounting expertise across the organization through knowledge sharing, training and guidance on complex accounting matters.

 

What you’ll bring

  • You have a degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a comparable field and several years of senior-level experience in Technical Accounting, Accounting Advisory, Group Accounting or Audit, ideally in a complex international organization.

  • You have excellent knowledge of IFRS and HGB and strong practical experience applying accounting standards to complex and judgmental transactions.

  • You have a proven track record of independently developing accounting conclusions and preparing high-quality technical accounting papers, assessments and audit documentation.

  • You are highly analytical and can quickly understand complex business models, contracts and transactions and translate their economic substance into appropriate accounting treatment.

  • You combine deep technical expertise with a pragmatic and implementation-oriented mindset and can drive accounting conclusions through to operational implementation.

  • You are comfortable taking ownership of complex topics, challenging existing approaches and influencing stakeholders across Finance and the wider organization.

  • You communicate complex accounting matters clearly and convincingly to both accounting specialists and senior non-accounting stakeholders.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer (f/m/x)
data.description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Enpal Energy is Enpal’s electricity division, making clean energy accessible to every household—from Germany’s most affordable electricity rates to smart energy solutions that optimally integrate generation, storage, and consumption.

With ambitious growth targets and a rapidly expanding customer base, we are building a team that is actively shaping the German energy market. In doing so, we combine startup agility with the scale of a market leader—across all areas, from operations and technology to finance, customer support, and product development.

 

What you'll do:

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer (f/m/x) to take end-to-end ownership of building and scaling our core product systems. You'll design and implement reliable services across our stack, integrate with external platforms and teams, and own the full lifecycle from idea to deployment. You'll also help shape our technical direction and mentor other engineers.

  • Build and own complex solutions end-to-end, collaborating with your team and stakeholders to deliver product features that solve real user problems.

  • Design scalable backend services with NestJS/Node.js, create frontend experiences with Next.js/React, and architect data models with MongoDB.

  • Leverage your strong infrastructure expertise to design, deploy, and operate reliable cloud-native solutions in Azure.

  • Build and consume APIs, integrating with internal and external systems while collaborating with and guiding other engineering teams.

  • Own your deployments, build CI/CD pipelines, manage infrastructure as code, and maintain applications in production.

  • Drive code quality through testing, code reviews, and continuous integration, setting standards for the team.

  • Monitor systems, optimize performance, troubleshoot complex issues, and make architectural decisions for scalability.

  • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, foster a culture of clean code and best practices, and lead by example in technical discussions.

 

What you'll bring:

  • Strong experience delivering end-to-end software solutions and driving technical excellence.

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, or solid experience with other modern languages and willingness to learn our stack.

  • Solid hands-on experience working with IT infrastructure, cloud environments, and system architecture. Experience with Microsoft Azure is a strong plus.

  • Strong experience working with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases, including schema design and optimization.

  • Proven track record building and consuming APIs, with experience leading cross-team integrations.

  • Demonstrated ability to own projects from conception through deployment and maintenance.

  • Strong commitment to code quality, testing strategies, and building systems that scale.

  • Experience mentoring or leading other engineers.

 

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Next.js and NestJS specifically.

  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code tools (Terraform, Pulumi, etc.).

  • Strong experience building CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.).

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Experience with monitoring, observability, and performance optimization tools.

  • Experience designing system architecture for high-scale applications.

 

Our Engineering Culture value engineers who:

  • Take end-to-end ownership of their work.

  • Care deeply about code quality and testing.

  • Embrace responsibility for the full lifecycle of their applications—from development through production.

  • Collaborate effectively across teams and communicate clearly about technical decisions

  • Think about scalability and long-term system design.

  • Lead by example and help grow the skills of those around them.

Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

What we offer:

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

  • The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

  • The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.

  • Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.

  • Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.

  • Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.

  • The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.

  • Your extra boost - 29 + 2 vacation days, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance.

At Enpal, we are proud of the diversity of our team. No decisions are made on the basis of skin colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age, either during recruitment or employment. Enpal stands for a safe workplace and takes action against discrimination and harassment of any kind.

With tens of thousands of iMSys units installed and scalable processes, we make energy measurable, controllable, and economically viable—and, together with our partners, we are laying the groundwork for new business models for the energy transition.

About the Role

Our central data platform is the foundation that Analytics Engineering, BI and increasingly AI-enabled business teams build on top of. You’ll join the team of two Data Engineers, where you’ll define how we build. As a Senior Data Engineer, you build for other engineers rather than for end users or dashboards: you own the pipelines, integrations, tooling and guardrails that let others ship data products safely and fast. You'll work at the intersection of dbt, Snowflake, Airflow orchestration and infrastructure-as-code on Azure – hands-on, while also setting the technical direction for where the platform goes next.

Our data arrives from metering devices, operational and legacy systems, external partners and APIs. You own the ingestion and orchestration layer that collects, reshapes and delivers it, including the critical paths the business cannot operate without. You'll drive design decisions and reviews directly with stakeholders across the business domains, set the standards others build on, and turn ambiguous requirements into implementable designs.

 

What You'll Do

  • Design, build and operate scalable pipelines end to end - from source integration through dbt models on Snowflake, orchestrated with Airflow on Azure.

  • Own the integration layer. Connect the platform to heterogeneous source systems - operational databases, external partners, APIs - and make those integrations observable, and resilient.

  • Build self-service scaffolding and developer tooling so domain teams can create models, sources, and tests without touching platform internals.

  • Drive the platform vision. Define where our data platform needs to go - tooling, abstractions, self-service, guardrails - and break that direction into increments that land in production. Act as the technical authority for data platform architecture and set the patterns for other engineers to follow.

  • Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform, keeping environments reproducible and reviewable. Collaborate closely with the platform team to align deployment policies and CI/CD setup.

  • Enforce federated governance: data contracts, RBAC via Snowflake database roles, and domain ownership boundaries.

  • Support data privacy and compliance requirements, including metadata-driven PII handling.

  • Build observability and testing into the platform so failures are caught before they reach domain teams.

  • Partner with AE/BI leads to gather requirements, review designs, document patterns, and continuously lower the barrier to entry.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of data engineering experience; you have owned production-critical data platforms.

  • Deep, hands-on dbt experience at scale (especially operating the platform around data modelling).

  • Solid Snowflake knowledge: RBAC, performance, and warehouse management.

  • Comfort with IaC (Terraform) and GitOps (ArgoCD).

  • Experience with orchestration (Airflow) and containerized workloads (Kubernetes/AKS).

  • Familiarity with modern ingestion frameworks (dlt or similar).

  • Software engineering fundamentals: confident Python and advanced SQL, testing, reusable libraries, and a platform-as-product mindset.
